import base64
import json
import math
import re
from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from datetime import datetime
from hashlib import sha256
from types import MappingProxyType
from typing import Any, cast

type FrozenJsonValue = None | bool | int | float | str | tuple["FrozenJsonValue", ...] | Mapping[str, "FrozenJsonValue"]
type WorkflowProfileCatalogSnapshot = Mapping[str, FrozenJsonValue]
type ProjectWorkflowSelectionSnapshot = Mapping[str, FrozenJsonValue]
type WorkflowStageStateSnapshot = Mapping[str, FrozenJsonValue]
type WorkflowProfileMigrationSnapshot = Mapping[str, FrozenJsonValue]

WORKFLOW_PROFILE_SCHEMA_SHA256 = "@@SCHEMA_SHA256@@"
GOVERNED_WORKFLOW_CATALOG_SHA256 = "@@GOVERNED_WORKFLOW_CATALOG_SHA256@@"
APPROVED_WORKFLOW_PROFILE_CATALOG_SHA256 = "@@PROFILE_CATALOG_SHA256@@"
_SCHEMA: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(
    base64.b64decode(
        @@SCHEMA_JSON_BASE64@@
    ).decode("utf-8")
)
_APPROVED_CATALOG: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(
    base64.b64decode(
        @@APPROVED_CATALOG_JSON_BASE64@@
    ).decode("utf-8")
)
_DANGEROUS_KEYS = frozenset({"__proto__", "constructor", "prototype"})
_MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS = 4096
_DOCUMENT_TYPES = frozenset(
    {
        "research-observatory-workflow-profile-catalog",
        "research-observatory-project-workflow-selection",
        "research-observatory-workflow-stage-state",
        "research-observatory-workflow-profile-migration",
    }
)


def _record(value: object) -> Mapping[str, Any] | None:
    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return None
    candidate = cast(Mapping[object, Any], value)
    if any(not isinstance(key, str) or key in _DANGEROUS_KEYS for key in candidate):
        return None
    return cast(Mapping[str, Any], value)


def _deep_equal(left: object, right: object) -> bool:
    return left == right and type(left) is type(right)


def _stable_json(value: object) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        candidate = cast(Mapping[str, object], value)
        return "{" + ",".join(f"{json.dumps(key)}:{_stable_json(candidate[key])}" for key in sorted(candidate)) + "}"
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray):
        return "[" + ",".join(_stable_json(item) for item in value) + "]"
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))


def _owned_frozen(value: object) -> object:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        candidate = _record(value)
        if candidate is None:
            raise ValueError("workflow profile object contains unsafe keys")
        if len(candidate) > _MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS:
            raise ValueError("workflow profile object exceeds bound")
        return MappingProxyType({key: _owned_frozen(item) for key, item in candidate.items()})
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray):
        if len(value) > _MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS:
            raise ValueError("workflow profile collection exceeds bound")
        return tuple(_owned_frozen(item) for item in value)
    return value


def _schema_record(value: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError("generated workflow profile schema is malformed")
    return cast(dict[str, Any], value)


def _resolve_reference(reference: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
    prefix = "#/$defs/"
    if not isinstance(reference, str) or not reference.startswith(prefix):
        raise ValueError("unsupported workflow profile schema reference")
    return _schema_record(_schema_record(_SCHEMA["$defs"])[reference[len(prefix) :]])


def _type_matches(value: object, kind: object) -> bool:
    if kind == "null":
        return value is None
    if kind == "boolean":
        return isinstance(value, bool)
    if kind == "integer":
        return (
            isinstance(value, int | float)
            and not isinstance(value, bool)
            and math.isfinite(value)
            and float(value).is_integer()
            and abs(value) <= 9_007_199_254_740_991
        )
    if kind == "number":
        return isinstance(value, int | float) and not isinstance(value, bool) and math.isfinite(value)
    if kind == "string":
        return isinstance(value, str)
    if kind == "array":
        return isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray)
    if kind == "object":
        return _record(value) is not None
    return False


def _validation_errors(value: object, node: dict[str, Any], path: str) -> list[str]:
    if "$ref" in node:
        return _validation_errors(value, _resolve_reference(node["$ref"]), path)
    errors: list[str] = []
    if "const" in node and not _deep_equal(value, node["const"]):
        errors.append(f"{path}: const")
    enum = node.get("enum")
    if isinstance(enum, list) and not any(_deep_equal(value, item) for item in enum):
        errors.append(f"{path}: enum")
    alternatives = node.get("oneOf")
    if isinstance(alternatives, list):
        matches = sum(not _validation_errors(value, _schema_record(item), path) for item in alternatives)
        if matches != 1:
            errors.append(f"{path}: alternatives")
    raw_types = node.get("type")
    types = raw_types if isinstance(raw_types, list) else [] if raw_types is None else [raw_types]
    if types and not any(_type_matches(value, kind) for kind in types):
        errors.append(f"{path}: type")
    if isinstance(value, int | float) and not isinstance(value, bool) and math.isfinite(value):
        if isinstance(node.get("minimum"), int | float) and value < node["minimum"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: minimum")
        if isinstance(node.get("maximum"), int | float) and value > node["maximum"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: maximum")
    if isinstance(value, str):
        if isinstance(node.get("minLength"), int) and len(value) < node["minLength"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: minLength")
        if isinstance(node.get("maxLength"), int) and len(value) > node["maxLength"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: maxLength")
        if isinstance(node.get("pattern"), str) and re.search(node["pattern"], value) is None:
            errors.append(f"{path}: pattern")
        if node.get("format") == "date-time":
            try:
                parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
                if parsed.year < 1 or not value.endswith("Z"):
                    errors.append(f"{path}: format")
            except ValueError:
                errors.append(f"{path}: format")
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray):
        if isinstance(node.get("minItems"), int) and len(value) < node["minItems"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: minItems")
        if isinstance(node.get("maxItems"), int) and len(value) > node["maxItems"]:
            return [*errors, f"{path}: maxItems"]
        if node.get("uniqueItems") is True and len({_stable_json(item) for item in value}) != len(value):
            errors.append(f"{path}: uniqueItems")
        if isinstance(node.get("items"), dict):
            for index, item in enumerate(value):
                errors.extend(_validation_errors(item, _schema_record(node["items"]), f"{path}/{index}"))
    candidate = _record(value)
    if candidate is not None and ("object" in types or isinstance(node.get("properties"), dict)):
        required = node.get("required", [])
        if isinstance(required, list):
            for key in required:
                if isinstance(key, str) and key not in candidate:
                    errors.append(f"{path}/{key}: required")
        properties = node.get("properties", {})
        if not isinstance(properties, dict):
            raise ValueError("generated workflow profile schema properties are malformed")
        if node.get("additionalProperties") is False:
            for key in candidate:
                if key not in properties:
                    errors.append(f"{path}/{key}: additional property")
        for key, child_schema in properties.items():
            if key in candidate:
                errors.extend(_validation_errors(candidate[key], _schema_record(child_schema), f"{path}/{key}"))
    return errors


def _definition(name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return _schema_record(_schema_record(_SCHEMA["$defs"])[name])


def _unique(values: Sequence[object]) -> bool:
    return len({_stable_json(value) for value in values}) == len(values)


def _profile_map(catalog: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]]:
    profiles = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], catalog["profiles"])
    return {cast(str, profile["profileId"]): profile for profile in profiles}


def _expected_profile_reference(catalog: Mapping[str, Any], profile: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    governed = cast(Mapping[str, Any], catalog["governedReference"])
    return {
        "referenceId": governed["referenceId"],
        "referenceVersion": governed["referenceVersion"],
        "workflowCatalogHash": governed["workflowCatalogHash"],
        "pageContractsHash": governed["pageContractsHash"],
        "profileCatalogVersion": catalog["profileCatalogVersion"],
        "profileCatalogHash": APPROVED_WORKFLOW_PROFILE_CATALOG_SHA256,
        "profileId": profile["profileId"],
        "profileVersion": profile["profileVersion"],
        "profileRevision": profile["profileRevision"],
        "sourceWorkflowHash": profile["sourceWorkflowHash"],
    }


def _exact_profile(catalog: Mapping[str, Any], value: object) -> Mapping[str, Any] | None:
    reference = _record(value)
    if reference is None:
        return None
    profile_id = reference.get("profileId")
    profile = _profile_map(catalog).get(profile_id) if isinstance(profile_id, str) else None
    return (
        profile
        if profile is not None
        and _stable_json(reference) == _stable_json(_expected_profile_reference(catalog, profile))
        else None
    )


def _immediate_intent_revision(prior_value: object, target_value: object) -> bool:
    prior = _record(prior_value)
    target = _record(target_value)
    return bool(
        prior is not None
        and target is not None
        and prior["intentId"] == target["intentId"]
        and target["revision"] == prior["revision"] + 1
        and target["revisionId"] != prior["revisionId"]
        and target["revisionContentHash"] != prior["revisionContentHash"]
    )


def _semantic_stage_mapping(
    from_profile: Mapping[str, Any], to_profile: Mapping[str, Any], item: Mapping[str, Any]
) -> bool:
    source = next(
        (
            stage
            for stage in cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], from_profile["stages"])
            if stage["stageKey"] == item["fromStageKey"]
        ),
        None,
    )
    target = next(
        (
            stage
            for stage in cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], to_profile["stages"])
            if stage["stageKey"] == item["targetStageKey"]
        ),
        None,
    )
    if source is None:
        return False
    if item["disposition"] == "retain":
        return bool(
            target is not None
            and target["stageKey"] == source["stageKey"]
            and target["pageContractId"] == source["pageContractId"]
        )
    if item["disposition"] == "map":
        return bool(target is not None and target["stageKey"] != source["stageKey"])
    return target is None and item["targetStageKey"] is None


def workflow_profile_catalog_errors(value: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    try:
        errors = _validation_errors(value, _definition("WorkflowProfileCatalog"), "$")
        if errors:
            return tuple(dict.fromkeys(errors))
        catalog = cast(Mapping[str, Any], _record(value))
        profiles = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], catalog["profiles"])
        if _stable_json(catalog) != _stable_json(_APPROVED_CATALOG):
            errors.append("catalog-binds-governed-reference")
        if not _unique([profile["profileId"] for profile in profiles]):
            errors.append("catalog-profile-identities-are-exact")
        for profile in profiles:
            stages = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], profile["stages"])
            if not _unique([stage["stageKey"] for stage in stages]) or [stage["order"] for stage in stages] != list(
                range(1, len(stages) + 1)
            ):
                errors.append("profile-stages-are-ordered-and-unique")
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(errors))
    except KeyError, TypeError, ValueError:
        return ("workflow-profile-catalog-structure-invalid",)


def project_workflow_selection_errors(catalog_value: object, value: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if workflow_profile_catalog_errors(catalog_value):
        return ("workflow-profile-catalog-invalid",)
    try:
        errors = _validation_errors(value, _definition("ProjectWorkflowSelection"), "$")
        if errors:
            return tuple(dict.fromkeys(errors))
        catalog = cast(Mapping[str, Any], _record(catalog_value))
        selection = cast(Mapping[str, Any], _record(value))
        if (
            _exact_profile(catalog, selection["profile"]) is None
            or selection["projectId"] == selection["selectionId"]
            or selection["selectionId"] == selection["selectionRevisionId"]
            or cast(Mapping[str, Any], selection["researchIntent"])["intentId"]
            == cast(Mapping[str, Any], selection["researchIntent"])["revisionId"]
        ):
            errors.append("selection-binds-catalog-profile-and-intent")
        parent = _record(selection["parentSelection"])
        revision = cast(int, selection["revision"])
        if (revision == 1 and parent is not None) or (
            revision > 1
            and (
                parent is None
                or parent["revision"] != revision - 1
                or parent["selectionId"] != selection["selectionId"]
                or parent["selectionRevisionId"] == selection["selectionRevisionId"]
                or parent["revisionContentHash"] == selection["revisionContentHash"]
                or _exact_profile(catalog, parent["profile"]) is None
            )
        ):
            errors.append("selection-lineage-is-immediate")
        impact = _record(selection["impactPreview"])
        if (revision == 1 and impact is not None) or (
            revision > 1
            and (
                impact is None
                or parent is None
                or _stable_json(impact["priorSelection"]) != _stable_json(parent)
                or _stable_json(impact["targetProfile"]) != _stable_json(selection["profile"])
                or impact["historyPolicy"] != "preserve"
            )
        ):
            errors.append("profile-change-binds-impact-preview")
        accepted_migration = _record(selection["acceptedMigration"])
        if revision == 1:
            if accepted_migration is not None:
                errors.append("profile-change-binds-intent-and-human-acceptance")
        elif (
            parent is None
            or accepted_migration is None
            or _stable_json(parent["profile"]) == _stable_json(selection["profile"])
            or not _immediate_intent_revision(parent["researchIntent"], selection["researchIntent"])
            or _stable_json(accepted_migration["fromProfile"]) != _stable_json(parent["profile"])
            or _stable_json(accepted_migration["toProfile"]) != _stable_json(selection["profile"])
            or _stable_json(accepted_migration["priorResearchIntent"]) != _stable_json(parent["researchIntent"])
            or _stable_json(accepted_migration["targetResearchIntent"]) != _stable_json(selection["researchIntent"])
            or _stable_json(cast(Mapping[str, Any], accepted_migration["acceptance"])["decidedBy"])
            != _stable_json(selection["selectedBy"])
        ):
            errors.append("profile-change-binds-intent-and-human-acceptance")
        if impact is not None and parent is not None:
            prior_profile = _exact_profile(catalog, parent["profile"])
            target_profile = _exact_profile(catalog, selection["profile"])
            items = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], impact["priorStageStates"])
            prior_keys = (
                {stage["stageKey"] for stage in cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], prior_profile["stages"])}
                if prior_profile
                else set()
            )
            target_keys = (
                {stage["stageKey"] for stage in cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], target_profile["stages"])}
                if target_profile
                else set()
            )
            if not _unique([(item["stageStateId"], item["stageStateRevisionId"]) for item in items]) or any(
                item["stageStateId"] == item["stageStateRevisionId"]
                or item["fromStageKey"] not in prior_keys
                or (item["targetStageKey"] is not None and item["targetStageKey"] not in target_keys)
                or (item["disposition"] in {"retain", "map"} and item["targetStageKey"] is None)
                for item in items
            ):
                errors.append("impact-preview-preserves-stage-history")
            if (
                prior_profile is not None
                and target_profile is not None
                and any(not _semantic_stage_mapping(prior_profile, target_profile, item) for item in items)
            ):
                errors.append("migration-disposition-is-semantic")
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(errors))
    except KeyError, TypeError, ValueError:
        return ("project-workflow-selection-structure-invalid",)


def workflow_stage_state_errors(
    catalog_value: object,
    selection_value: object,
    value: object,
    current_primary_state_value: object | None = None,
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if project_workflow_selection_errors(catalog_value, selection_value):
        return ("project-workflow-selection-invalid",)
    try:
        errors = _validation_errors(value, _definition("WorkflowStageState"), "$")
        if errors:
            return tuple(dict.fromkeys(errors))
        catalog = cast(Mapping[str, Any], _record(catalog_value))
        selection = cast(Mapping[str, Any], _record(selection_value))
        state = cast(Mapping[str, Any], _record(value))
        expected_selection = {
            "selectionId": selection["selectionId"],
            "selectionRevisionId": selection["selectionRevisionId"],
            "revision": selection["revision"],
            "revisionContentHash": selection["revisionContentHash"],
        }
        profile = _exact_profile(catalog, state["profile"])
        if (
            state["projectId"] != selection["projectId"]
            or _stable_json(state["selection"]) != _stable_json(expected_selection)
            or _stable_json(state["profile"]) != _stable_json(selection["profile"])
            or profile is None
        ):
            errors.append("stage-state-binds-selection-and-profile")
        parent = _record(state["parentState"])
        revision = cast(int, state["revision"])
        if (
            state["stageStateId"] == state["stageStateRevisionId"]
            or (revision == 1 and parent is not None)
            or (
                revision > 1
                and (
                    parent is None
                    or parent["revision"] != revision - 1
                    or parent["stageStateId"] != state["stageStateId"]
                    or parent["stageStateRevisionId"] == state["stageStateRevisionId"]
                    or parent["revisionContentHash"] == state["revisionContentHash"]
                )
            )
        ):
            errors.append("stage-state-binds-selection-and-profile")
        completed = state["status"] == "completed"
        attention = state["status"] in {"attention-required", "blocked"}
        stale = state["status"] == "stale"
        skipped = state["status"] == "skipped-with-rationale"
        if (
            completed != bool(state["completionEvidenceIds"])
            or attention != (state["attention"] is not None)
            or stale != bool(state["staleCauses"])
            or skipped != (state["skipRationale"] is not None)
        ):
            errors.append("stage-state-status-shape-is-consistent")
        stages = {
            stage["stageKey"]: stage
            for stage in cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], profile["stages"] if profile is not None else ())
        }
        if state["passNumber"] > 1 and (profile is None or profile["cyclePolicy"] != "revisitable"):
            errors.append("stage-state-pass-matches-cycle-policy")
        if state["navigationRole"] == "primary":
            stage = stages.get(state["stageKey"])
            if (
                stage is None
                or stage["pageContractId"] != state["pageContractId"]
                or state["supportReturn"] is not None
            ):
                errors.append("stage-state-binds-selection-and-profile")
        else:
            support = _record(state["supportReturn"])
            current = _record(support["currentPrimaryState"]) if support is not None else None
            primary = stages.get(current["stageKey"]) if current is not None else None
            provided_current = _record(current_primary_state_value)
            expected_current = (
                {
                    "stageStateId": provided_current["stageStateId"],
                    "stageStateRevisionId": provided_current["stageStateRevisionId"],
                    "revision": provided_current["revision"],
                    "revisionContentHash": provided_current["revisionContentHash"],
                    "projectId": provided_current["projectId"],
                    "selection": provided_current["selection"],
                    "profile": provided_current["profile"],
                    "stageKey": provided_current["stageKey"],
                    "pageContractId": provided_current["pageContractId"],
                    "passNumber": provided_current["passNumber"],
                    "status": provided_current["status"],
                }
                if provided_current is not None
                else None
            )
            if (
                current is None
                or primary is None
                or primary["pageContractId"] != current["pageContractId"]
                or provided_current is None
                or provided_current["navigationRole"] != "primary"
                or provided_current["status"] != "current"
                or workflow_stage_state_errors(catalog_value, selection_value, provided_current)
                or _stable_json(current) != _stable_json(expected_current)
                or current["stageStateId"] == current["stageStateRevisionId"]
                or current["stageStateId"] == state["stageStateId"]
                or current["stageStateRevisionId"] == state["stageStateRevisionId"]
                or current["projectId"] != state["projectId"]
                or _stable_json(current["selection"]) != _stable_json(expected_selection)
                or _stable_json(current["profile"]) != _stable_json(state["profile"])
                or (current["passNumber"] > 1 and (profile is None or profile["cyclePolicy"] != "revisitable"))
            ):
                errors.append("supporting-tool-return-is-explicit")
            registered = set(cast(Sequence[str], catalog["registeredToolPageContractIds"]))
            primary_pages = {stage["pageContractId"] for stage in stages.values()}
            if state["pageContractId"] not in registered or state["pageContractId"] in primary_pages:
                errors.append("supporting-tool-is-governed-and-outside-primary-sequence")
            if state["stageKey"] != f"{cast(str, state['pageContractId'])[:-5]}-1":
                errors.append("supporting-tool-identity-is-governed")
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(errors))
    except KeyError, TypeError, ValueError:
        return ("workflow-stage-state-structure-invalid",)


def workflow_profile_migration_errors(catalog_value: object, value: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if workflow_profile_catalog_errors(catalog_value):
        return ("workflow-profile-catalog-invalid",)
    try:
        errors = _validation_errors(value, _definition("WorkflowProfileMigration"), "$")
        if errors:
            return tuple(dict.fromkeys(errors))
        catalog = cast(Mapping[str, Any], _record(catalog_value))
        migration = cast(Mapping[str, Any], _record(value))
        from_profile = _exact_profile(catalog, migration["fromProfile"])
        to_profile = _exact_profile(catalog, migration["toProfile"])
        if (
            from_profile is None
            or to_profile is None
            or _stable_json(migration["fromProfile"]) == _stable_json(migration["toProfile"])
            or migration["historyPolicy"] != "preserve"
            or migration["requiresHumanAcceptance"] is not True
            or not _immediate_intent_revision(migration["priorResearchIntent"], migration["targetResearchIntent"])
        ):
            errors.append("migration-binds-exact-profile-revisions")
        if from_profile is not None and to_profile is not None:
            mappings = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], migration["stageMappings"])
            source_keys = [stage["stageKey"] for stage in cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], from_profile["stages"])]
            mapped_keys = [item["fromStageKey"] for item in mappings]
            target_keys = {stage["stageKey"] for stage in cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], to_profile["stages"])}
            if (
                not _unique(mapped_keys)
                or sorted(cast(list[str], mapped_keys)) != sorted(cast(list[str], source_keys))
                or any(
                    (
                        item["disposition"] in {"retain", "map"}
                        and (item["targetStageKey"] is None or item["targetStageKey"] not in target_keys)
                    )
                    or (item["targetStageKey"] is not None and item["targetStageKey"] not in target_keys)
                    for item in mappings
                )
            ):
                errors.append("migration-covers-prior-stages")
            if any(not _semantic_stage_mapping(from_profile, to_profile, item) for item in mappings):
                errors.append("migration-disposition-is-semantic")
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(errors))
    except KeyError, TypeError, ValueError:
        return ("workflow-profile-migration-structure-invalid",)


def decode_workflow_profile_catalog(value: object) -> WorkflowProfileCatalogSnapshot | None:
    try:
        owned = _owned_frozen(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return cast(WorkflowProfileCatalogSnapshot, owned) if not workflow_profile_catalog_errors(owned) else None


def decode_project_workflow_selection(catalog: object, value: object) -> ProjectWorkflowSelectionSnapshot | None:
    try:
        owned = _owned_frozen(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return (
        cast(ProjectWorkflowSelectionSnapshot, owned) if not project_workflow_selection_errors(catalog, owned) else None
    )


def decode_workflow_stage_state(
    catalog: object,
    selection: object,
    value: object,
    current_primary_state: object | None = None,
) -> WorkflowStageStateSnapshot | None:
    try:
        owned = _owned_frozen(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return (
        cast(WorkflowStageStateSnapshot, owned)
        if not workflow_stage_state_errors(catalog, selection, owned, current_primary_state)
        else None
    )


def decode_workflow_profile_migration(catalog: object, value: object) -> WorkflowProfileMigrationSnapshot | None:
    try:
        owned = _owned_frozen(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return (
        cast(WorkflowProfileMigrationSnapshot, owned) if not workflow_profile_migration_errors(catalog, owned) else None
    )


def canonical_workflow_profile_json(value: object) -> str:
    candidate = _record(value)
    if candidate is None or candidate.get("documentType") not in _DOCUMENT_TYPES:
        raise ValueError("invalid workflow profile contract document")
    return _stable_json(value)


def workflow_profile_record_sha256(value: object) -> str:
    return f"sha256:{sha256(canonical_workflow_profile_json(value).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()}"
